import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

# Parse input
a1, b1 = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
a2, b2 = int(data[2]), int(data[3])
a3, b3 = int(data[4]), int(data[5])

def can_place_paintings(a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3):
    # Check all possible orientations
    # First painting can be a2 x b2 or b2 x a2
    # Second painting can be a3 x b3 or b3 x a3
    for (p1, q1) in [(a2, b2), (b2, a2)]:
        for (p2, q2) in [(a3, b3), (b3, a3)]:
            # Check if they fit side by side
            if (p1 + p2 <= a1 and max(q1, q2) <= b1) or (p1 + p2 <= b1 and max(q1, q2) <= a1):
                return "YES"
            # Check if they fit one above the other
            if (max(p1, p2) <= a1 and q1 + q2 <= b1) or (max(p1, p2) <= b1 and q1 + q2 <= a1):
                return "YES"
    return "NO"

print(can_place_paintings(a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3))
